top_comments.body:
Same issue here, getting repeated API Error (529 "type":"overloaded_error") responses while using Claude Code from the terminal on Ubuntu 24.04.

The retries escalate but eventually all fail due to overload. This started happening about 30 minutes ago and is blocking my work.

Would be great to know if there’s an ETA for resolution or any recommended workaround in the meantime.
